name: garnet
notes: Garnet group; inclusion garnets are mostly pyrope-rich

name: clinopyroxene
notes: Includes Cr-diopside and omphacite in loose usage

name: chromite
notes: Used loosely in inclusion studies for Cr-rich spinel

name: CaSiO3 phase
notes: Reported by composition only; structure (e.g. walstromite, breyite) or a former Ca-perovskite are interpretations

name: MgSiO3 phase
notes: Reported by composition only; a former bridgmanite is an interpretation

name: polyphase inclusion (bulk)
notes: Bulk analysis of an intergrowth, not a single phase
